digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler, ticket store, project mapping
propositions: The bridge is hardcoded to a single tracker project at three independent points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair building, and applier cross-project guard, preventing teams from syncing multiple projects against one codebase

A shared ticket store with per-ticket project and repos fields must own the project mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent two repos fetching different project subsets from diffing each other as remote deletions

Migration to tri-state project field (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync) requires zero events written, using idempotent ensure unit seeding rather than per-ticket edit events
Multi-project inbound fetch must fan-out over configured projects and merge enrichment data (parents, comments, issuelinks) per project while keeping per-query truncation ceiling scoped per project
Outbound dispatch must use per-ticket project on create and relax cross-project guard from single configured project to set membership

A store with >1 project must carry multi-project-bridge in required_capabilities and atomically stamp .store-compat.json alongside mapping mutations to prevent older binaries from duplicating issues across projects
